name: Admin Linktrees
description: Admin creates linktrees (internal name + unique handle, personal/company kind), edits identity, tiered buttons (1 primary, <=1 featured, pairs of 2, <=6 rows), PWA block and vCard data from /panel/linktrees, and assigns a linktree as QR card destination. Public URL is /lk/@handle; the backend rejects handle collisions, reserved handles and tier cardinality violations.
